entities.what: The biggest house of the west farmstead: a thatched hip-and-gable roof seen gable-on, a small pale gable vent near the top and the thatch sweeping down on both sides; its walls are hidden by a brushwood fence or hedge in front. Bare trees stand in front of and through it.
entities.vis: part: walls behind the fence; three or four bare trunks (t5) cross the roof
entities.src: 余辉: 寂静的谷场 (setting); 名画记: 寂静的谷场 (pin 2) is at u 34100, just east
entities.note: Read at zoom 2.2 (fC.jpg) and 3 (insp_34100_780.jpg). Roof top: rises from (33799, 745) to (33876, 681), rounded ridge v 667-674 over u 33890-33985, east slope (33995, 681)->(34099, 790)->(34149, 822). Gable vent: pale triangle u 33880-33925, v 693-713. The smooth darker roof wash ends at an eave line v ~780-790 (u 33799-34104); below it to v ~900 is the coarser crossed hatching of the fence S1.str.fence_brush_33760. Reading: a roof turned gable-on to the viewer, so its long axis runs north (receding); the east part, sloping lower to (34149, 822), may be a lean-to. PLACEHOLDER FOOTPRINT: front at the fence (v 888-892), depth 150 px of v, no shift. SCALE CUE: eave span 335 px (u 33785-34120) at v ~785-805. SECOND PASS (farms): the east hip comes down to a corner post. The thatched east slope's edge runs unbroken from about (34000, 700) through (34117, 793) to its lower corner at (34150, 843-848) (post_n.jpg zoom 3, bighouse_hp.jpg zoom 1.7). Under that corner a thin post stands from v 848 to its foot at (34142, 887) (t5 saw it too: 'a post at 34140-34148 down to v 885'). Recorded as this house's SE corner post (a bay), and the se base corner moves onto its foot (was est (34130, 892)). The hatched triangle t5 called 'the small thatched shed at the yard's west side (hatched gable 34117-34155, v 805-852)' is this house's east hip end, or a lean-to under it: no separate building. The hatched band of S1.str.fence_brush_33760 runs on under the corner to v ~890 west of the post, so here the band stands in front of the wall line.

entities.what: A thatched barn or shed turned gable-on to the viewer: a small pale gable vent with a king post at the top, long ragged thatch fringe at the eave, and an open front on posts with crates or boxes and a sloping board inside (props, t6). The clearest building of the farmsteads.

Roof seen gable-on, so its long axis runs north. PLACEHOLDER BACK CORNERS at v 765 (depth ~110-117 px), no shift. entities.name: long farmhouse behind the barn (west gable)
entities.what: A long low house behind the open barn: a straight ridge and a roof of fine close strokes in rows (thatch, probably; no round tile ends are painted), with a small hip-and-gable end facing west; its east part, beyond the barn, shows an open front with a few posts over the threshing floor. Its east end runs in under the big willow.
entities.vis: part: front and base hidden by the barn S1.bld.barn_open_34860; east end under the willow crown (t6 tree at u ~35180-35235)
entities.note: Read at zoom 1.55-3 (fE.jpg, g_back.jpg, insp_35080_790.jpg, insp_35250_850.jpg). Ridge v 600-606 from u 34795 to at least 35060; eave line v 686-696 from u 34750 to about 35130 (a horizontal dark line at v ~692 runs to the willow trunk). West end: pale gable triangle u 34750-34802, v 603-660, with a king post, the hip below it at u 34737-34757 (v 628-693). ROOF MATERIAL unclear: fine strokes in horizontal rows, no tile ends at the eave; the restyle draws blue tile (its habit here). Thin vertical strokes at u 35050-35100, v 750-830, under its east part are recorded apart as S1.str.posts_35075 (its front posts, or a lean-to or frame on the threshing floor). PLACEHOLDER FOOTPRINT: front at v 762 (just behind the barn's placeholder back), depth 122 px, no shift. SCALE CUE: eave 390-405 px long at v ~692. SECOND PASS (farms), roof material: the eave is a crisp, straight double line at v 690-700 from u 34800 to 35100, with no ragged fringe like the barn's thatch (v 796-809). The slope is laid in rows of small scalloped marks, not the barn's slanted dashes (roofs_n.jpg, roofs_hp.jpg zoom 2.6). Those two signs lean to tile or a neatly trimmed roof, against the thatch the note calls probable. Both readings stay; a question for the lead, since it changes the kit part.

entities.name: brushwood fence (or hedge) in front of the west farmstead
entities.what: A long band of dense crossed hatching in front of the west farmstead's houses, from u ~33395 to ~34120, read as a brushwood (wattle) fence or a hedge; its west end rises into a rounded hump. It hides the houses' walls.
entities.vis: part: bare trunks in front of it
entities.note: Foot line read at zoom 1.7-2.2 (fB.jpg, fC.jpg, g_33280.jpg); top v ~780-830. Height 60-110 px (foot to top), i.e. tall for a fence: SCALE CUE. READINGS: (a) a brushwood fence or hedge round the farmstead (the crossed short strokes differ from the smoother roof wash above them); (b) the lower thatch of the houses coming down almost to the ground. The rounded HUMP at its west end (u 33400-33540, top (33491, 793)) is drawn the same way; the restyle paints it as a golden haystack: if it is a free-standing straw stack, it is t5's prop (listed in my report). MERGE: t4's "bush at 33375-33450, v 813-905" (left to t5) is this belt's west end; t5 reads the hatched front slopes above it as the thatch of S1.bld.farmhouse_back_33450 and S1.bld.farmhouse_gable_33670, and recorded no straw stack, so the hump (top (33491, 793)) stays part of this belt or of those roofs; the restyle's golden haystack is not recorded. Second pass: settle hump against thatch at zoom 2. SECOND PASS (farms), the hump: it is not a free-standing stack. At zoom 1.7-2.6 (hump_hp.jpg, hump_z.jpg, h1_norm.jpg) its outline is one crisp, smooth line from (33430, 845) up through (33500, 800) to (33560, 778), where it meets S1.bld.farmhouse_gable_33670's west eave corner (33575, 772). The surface inside is the same short slanted dashes as the rest of the band and as the thatch on the gable house's east slope (33680-33760, v 780-850), with no boundary between them. The band's lower edge is a straight dark line at v 867-881 (33430-33780), with a paler strip below it (v 881-899) and then the ground line. Nothing separates the hump from the band, so no prop is proposed. The evidence leans two ways. In the WEST (33400-33780) it favours reading (b): the smooth outline and the thatch dashes make the hump the west hip of a low thatched roof, with its eave at v ~875 (the front slope of the gable house's roof, or a low thatched wing in front of S1.bld.farmhouse_back_33450). In the EAST (33780-34150) it favours reading (a): S1.bld.farmhouse_thatched_33955's east hip ends at a corner post at (34142, 848-887) (see that entity), while the band runs on below the corner to v ~890, so there it stands in front of the wall line. The builder must not settle this silently. If the lead takes (b) for the west part, this line would start at u ~33780, and the west part becomes roof (a building entity, or eaves of S1.bld.farmhouse_gable_33670 lowered to v ~875).

entities.name: low hedge round the yard east of the large farmhouse
entities.what: Low dense hatching (a brush fence or hedge) closing the small yard east of the large farmhouse on its south side, rising into a taller clump on its east side.
entities.vis: part: faint
entities.note: Read at zoom 3 (insp_34230_800.jpg): a low band of small strokes u 34122-34302, v 873-916 along the yard's south side, and a taller clump u 34284-34410, v 822-910 on its east. Readings: a brush fence or a hedge (bushes). The restyle draws a wattle fence here. SCALE CUE: 40 px tall (south band), ~90 px (east clump). MERGE: t6 recorded the east part of this belt as hedge shrubs, S1.tree.shrubs_34385 (bushes from u ~34290 to ~34530, top v 785-830, foot on the ground line at v ~915-925; small dark leaf or twig clusters, no stakes or rails at zoom 3; the farmer S1.fig.farmer_by_hedge_34472 stands behind its east end), retired as the same strokes; the line now runs on east to (34530, 920) from t6's reading. BOTH READINGS for the builder: a hedge of low bushes (t6; a new tree form, "hedge shrubs", for the needs list) or a brushwood fence (structures_e). SECOND PASS (farms), bushes or brushwood: at zoom 2.6 (hedge_n.jpg) the east clump (34284-34430, v 788-918) is drawn as small rounded leaf-dab clusters with rounded tops, and no uprights, stakes or rails. That is bushes, t6's reading. The low south band (34122-34302, v 873-916) is too faint to tell.

entities.name: brushwood fence in front of the east farmstead

Its west end meets S1.str.hedge_yard_34265 at the twin elm S1.tree.bare_elm_twin_34552. entities.name: small plank bridge (草桥)
entities.what: A long low plank bridge on thin wooden posts, its deck covered with brushwood or turf (rough dotted strokes on top), running east-west from the west bank under the big bare trees to the east bank at the next big tree; no railing. A small empty boat (t8) lies under and south-west of it.
entities.vis: full
entities.src: sections.md S1: a small wooden bridge, u ≈ 36100-36500
entities.note: Read at zoom 2.9 (br_w.jpg, br_e.jpg) and 3 (insp_36350_1100.jpg). DECK: a dark band v ~1003-1052 whose south edge runs v 1052 at the west bank (u 36125) to v 1032 at the east bank (u 36608) and whose top edge rises from the west end to v 1003-1005 at u 36300-36400 (the west third ramps up off the bank). Both ends meet the bank tops level, so the deck lines are taken at ground level (H 0). POSTS (bays = their feet in the water, support stream): u 36228-36243 (two, feet v 1090-1098), 36311-36318 (foot 1062), 36328-36331 (1075), 36349-36355 (1090), 36362-36373 (1093), 36450-36460 (1063), 36474-36484 (1067), 36488-36494 (1065), 36532-36550 (1090). The shorter posts (feet v 1062-1075) may be a north row and the longer (1088-1098) a south row, but the pairing is not readable. SCALE CUES: span 483 px (u 36125-36608); deck band 30-45 px of v; deck south edge to post foot 40-54 px (36232: 1050->1090; 36352: 1038->1090; 36540: 1036->1090), i.e. the deck stands about 0.5-0.7 m over the water; post spacing 8-90 px. The restyle draws it the same (a plank bridge on posts), about 20-30 px off. MERGE: t8's boat S1.veh.boat_sampan_36440 lies under the bridge's west half. The line at its east end (u 36442-36446, v ~1125-1180) stops 40-60 px below this bridge's nearest post foot (36455, 1063); second pass: a mooring pole in the stream bed (S1.prop.mooring_pole_36444, low), not a rope to a post.

entities.name: two posts (a frame, or an open lean-to) at the threshing floor's north edge
entities.what: A thin upright post at the north edge of the threshing floor (u 35050-35065, v 750-830), under the east part of the long farmhouse's eave and west of the big willow, and a taller post with a forked top at u ~35150 (v 755-868), just behind the bench's east leg; a beam-like line may join their tops (a frame, or an open lean-to).
entities.vis: part: faint; the willow's hanging shoots cross them
entities.note: Read at zoom 2.6-3 (g3_34870.jpg, insp_35080_790.jpg): strokes at u 35050-35065 and 35090-35107, v 750-830 (feet est). READINGS: (a) the front posts of the long farmhouse S1.bld.farmhouse_long_34950, whose east part would then come forward to v ~830; (b) the posts of an open lean-to or a frame standing on the floor (the restyle draws a thatched lean-to on posts here, but the strokes show no roof between the farmhouse's eave at v ~692 and the posts' tops); (c) the big willow's hanging shoots. The forked pole at u ~35150 and the bench at u 35100-35165 are t6's props, not part of this. MERGE: the forked pole at u ~35150 (structures_e left it to t6 as a prop; t6 left it back as the open shed's east post) is folded in here as this structure's east post: post_fork_foot (35155, 868), post_fork_top (35150, 755); on the merge's zoom-1.8 crop a beam-like line at v ~780-790 runs between the posts' tops under the willow's head. t6 reads an open lean-to with a thatched roof at u ~35000-35185, v 700-770 over these posts (its shoots-or-thatch strokes hang there); structures_e reads no roof between the farmhouse's eave (v ~692) and the posts. BOTH READINGS stay: the builder settles posts-and-beam (a frame) or a lean-to as a choice. t6's props under it: S1.prop.long_plank_shed_35060, S1.prop.jar_shed_35058, S1.fig.figure_in_shed_35108. SECOND PASS (farms): a duplicate in disguise with S1.fig.figure_in_shed_35108. This structure's east post ('strokes at u 35090-35107, v 750-830', post_e_top (35095, 760)) and t6's figure ('a curved stroke from (35097, 790) up to (35105, 768) and over to (35120, 773), with a dark blob at (35107-35117, 787-797)') are the same strokes. Read in colour at zoom 3-4 and high-pass at zoom 2.6 (insp_35090_790.jpg, shed_nat4.jpg, lean_hp.jpg, fork_n5.jpg), they are an inverted V: a west stroke from (35104, 760) down to (35093, 795) and an east stroke from (35108, 765) down to (35118, 800), with a dark mass in its east half (35110-35118, 780-800). (1) The strokes are tinted indigo, the garment colour; the west post at 35057 and the forked pole at 35150 are plain grey-black ink. (2) No shaft runs on below v ~800 to the ground at u 35092: the plank line at v 801-805 crosses plain silk there. A second dark mass under it at (35095-35115, 815-831) is where a crouching body would rest. So it is a figure, not a post. The frame then stands on the west post (35050-35065, v 750-830) and the forked pole (35155, 868); the line runs from one foot to the other. If the lead reads it as a post, keep this entity as it was and retire S1.fig.figure_in_shed_35108 instead: one of the two must go.

entities.name: path over the small bridge
entities.what: The path carried by the small plank bridge, from the west bank under the big bare trees across the inlet to the east bank, and up the bank to the main road east of the donkey driver.
entities.vis: part: the ends off the bridge are not painted
entities.note: On the bridge the edges are the deck lines of S1.str.small_bridge_36365 (u 36125-36608); the deck meets both banks level, so the whole path is at ground level. Off the bridge nothing is drawn: the west end stops at the west bank among the big trees' roots (est), and the east end climbs the north bank's top (S1.grd.bank_36900, v ~1000-1025) to meet S1.road.main_east at about (36840, 932) (est). Who walks it: nobody is painted on it.

entities.name: the stream at the small bridge, opening into the misty water at the scroll's start
entities.what: The stream (not the 汴河) under the small bridge: plain pale silk with the bridge's posts standing in it and a small empty boat lying in it (t8), bounded by the big trees' bank on the west, the layered north bank on the north and east, and the dark near bank at the bottom; land tongues (spits) reach into it from the west. East of about u 36850 it fades into plain silk (mist) and the seals.
entities.vis: part: under the bridge deck; east of u ~36850 and under the seals (u 37250-37560) it is plain silk
entities.src: sections.md S1: mist, sparse trees and water at the very start, ≈ 35000-37610
entities.note: WATER, because the bridge's posts stand in it (feet v 1062-1098) and the boat (t8, u 36170-36440, v 1128-1215) lies in it, and it is drawn as blank silk the way the other open water is. shore_n: the west bank's foot at the big trees' roots (u 36030-36125), then hidden under the deck: the line along the foot of the donkey path's bank (v ~980) is est (the strip between that bank and the deck, v 980-1003, may be water, the inlet's head, or bank: conf low); then the foot of the north bank (u 36615-36870), then the foot of the bank layers to the east (est). Between that bank and the east spit S1.grd.spit_east_37060 a pale arm (v ~1085-1150, u 36880-37250) belongs to the water. shore_s: the top of the dark near bank along the bottom (v 1592-1625), which fades out east of u ~36850. WEST: at u ~36000 it joins the pale band S1.water.wash_band_34400 (conf low) between the land tongues and the near bank. The restyle paints all of it as dry ground with grass and a stone-edged channel; never follow it here. DEPTH for the frame (support stream): the deck meets the bank tops level, and its south edge stands 54 px over the post foot straight below at u 36540 ((36540, 1036) -> (36540, 1090)), 52 px at u 36352 ((36352, 1038) -> (36352, 1090)): H ≈ -0.7 m (54/77), range -0.5 to -0.8; the west bank top (36125, 1052) over its waterline (36110, 1110) gives 58 px, -0.75 m. SECOND PASS (start): EXTENTS. shore_s is the near bank's top edge (S1.grd.bank_south_34400, same points). It runs on east to about 37250 and fades there; it is not lost at 36850. Its west end stays at u 36000, where it meets S1.water.wash_band_34400; the near bank's dark band itself begins at about 35900. shore_n follows the north bank's lowest stroke, which runs on east between the seals to the silk's end (S1.grd.bank_36900, below). The seals are measured by red pixels (R-G > 45): u 37248-37503 at v 51-319, u 37396-37538 at v 805-1007, u 37362-37567 at v 1138-1351, u 37424-37584 at v 1597-1756. The strip v 1007-1138 is covered by none of them. East of about 37250 the water between the east spit (S1.grd.spit_east_37060) and the near bank's end is plain silk (mist): close the polygon there, at the builder's choice.

entities.name: pale band below the farmsteads: water or a low flat
entities.what: A pale band of blank silk across the lower middle of the silk, between the dark bank below the farmsteads' terrace and the dark near bank at the bottom: either the stream running on west from the bridge, or a low pale flat of bare ground. Wide in the west (u 32850-34150), pinched at u ~33450-33650 and at the rocks (u 34150-34850), and wide again from u ~34650 east to the stream at the bridge.
entities.vis: faded
entities.note: BOTH READINGS (the lead or the user decides; the builder must not settle it silently). WATER: it is blank silk like the stream at the bridge (S1.water.stream_36500), it runs on from it at u ~36000, the land tongues S1.grd.spit_36150 and S1.grd.spit_36225 point east into it, and the scholars put water at the scroll's start; the great willows west of my range (隋堤烟柳, the Sui embankment) would then stand along its bank. GROUND: no ripple lines are drawn anywhere in it; the big willow at u ~32620-32820 west of my range has its roots at v ~1560-1600 on the band's south edge as if standing on its surface; and the restyle draws dry ground (it draws dry ground everywhere, though). shore_n: the foot of the dark bank S1.grd.bank_33650 (u 32850-34450), est round that bank's east end (u 34450-34650), then the foot of S1.grd.bank_35200 (u 34650-35700) and the south edge of the land tongue S1.grd.spit_36225 (u 35800-36000). shore_s: the top of the near bank S1.grd.bank_south_34400. At u 34150-34850 the two banks almost touch (v 1490-1505): only a thin pale strip connects the two halves. West of u 33000 it continues into structures_w's range (v ~1490-1600), where no water entity is recorded; structures_w notes the other way round that the DARK band v 1450-1600 at u 33100-33600 might be water or a hollow. Seen at zoom 3 (insp_lens.jpg) that dark band is made of tongue-shaped wash strokes pointing into the pale silk, like the land tongues by the bridge, so I read the pale silk as the water and the dark as land. MERGE: west of u 33000 nothing continues this band: structures_w recorded the ground there as banks (S1.grd.bank_32905, foot v 1486, and S1.grd.bank_32700, v 1580-1612, which runs inside this band's v range), and it reads the DARK band (v 1450-1600 from 32850 east) as the possible water, where this entity takes the PALE band. Water against ground is the ground pilot's open question for the user; the builder must not settle it silently. SECOND PASS (start), u 35400-36000 only: the lowest dark wash stroke above the band, which is the west end of S1.grd.spit_36225's layer, ends at v ~1385-1395 from 35500 to 35850. The step to the paler silk below measures 1392 at 35500 (weak, 96 -> 113), 1385-1390 at 35560-35700 (101 -> 120-125) and 1393 at 35780. So the shore is about 60 px lower there than the 1330 mapped from S1.grd.bank_35200's foot. At 35420 the dark ends at 1342. EXTENT: the band is pale only east of about 35650. At 35450-35600 the silk below v 1340 is one even mid-tone (104-115) down to the silk's edge, with no pale band and no near bank (see S1.grd.bank_south_34400). In this range the band's south shore (35000-35900) is drawn on no stroke. That is more evidence for the water-or-ground question: the pale band does not visibly join the stream's water west of about 35650. FRAME AGENT: shore_s's last two points move onto the near bank's top as the second pass (start) measured it, (35900, 1590) and (36000, 1582) (were 1592 est at both), so this band's south shore meets S1.water.stream_36500's shore_s at u 36000.

entities.name: faint steps on the terrace below the farmsteads
entities.what: Faint horizontal wash strokes across the broad, gently falling terrace between the farmsteads' bank and the big dark bank below: low steps or undulations in bare ground, with one curled bank edge at the west end.
entities.vis: faded
entities.note: Read at zoom 1-1.15 (m_32850.jpg, m_33650.jpg, w_32850.jpg, w_35250.jpg). bank_top_a: a thin curled line from (33361, 1062) up to (33378, 1037) and along to (33494, 1012) (zoom 1.8, t4stroke.jpg), fainter down-left to about (33290, 1105), with dark wash below it (u 33440-33650, v 1040-1060): the clearest step; it is the "bank stroke east of the east willow" t4 left to structures_e. entities.name: big dark bank below the terrace (west)
entities.what: A broad dark ink-wash band, streaked horizontally and darkest at its foot, falling from the terrace below the farmsteads to the pale band: the main slope of the ground in the west half of the range. Its foot bulges south at u ~33300-33700.

entities.note: Read at zoom 0.6-1 and 3 (gc_1.jpg, w_32850.jpg, w_33650.jpg, c_junction.jpg, insp_lens.jpg). Foot: the dark lower edge, clear: (33200, 1480) curving down to (33550, 1590) and up again to (34150, 1515). The east end fades at u ~34450-34600 (est), like a land tongue. HIGHER SIDE: north. HEIGHT: the band is 190-300 px of v, mostly depth; no figure or post stands on it; judged a slope of about 1-1.5 m in all. West of u 33000 it is structures_w's S1.grd.bank_32905 (top v 1392-1398, foot 1482-1486 at u 32800-33150). MERGE: continues west of u 33000 as structures_w's S1.grd.bank_32905 (at u 33000: top 1394/1395, foot 1486/1490). FRAME: its bank_foot stands on the support `stream` (support_by), the water's level: its foot is S1.water.wash_band_34400's shore_n at u 33000-34450 (the same points). This follows the band's WATER reading (conf low): if the lead or the user takes the band as ground, this goes back to the ground with it.

entities.name: near bank along the bottom of the silk
entities.what: The near ground along the bottom of the silk: a dark line or band (the bank's face) at the south edge of the pale band, with streaked bare ground below it to the silk's edge; rocks break through it at u 34190-34820. East of u ~36850 it fades into plain silk (mist).
entities.vis: part: runs off the silk's bottom edge (v ~1786); faint at u 34850-36000
entities.note: bank_top here is the line where the pale band meets the dark face (the shore, if the band is water); bank_foot the lower edge of the dark face. Read at zoom 0.6-1.35 (w_*.jpg, rocks.jpg, c_junction.jpg). u 34150-34850: the face is a broad dark band v 1504-1578 (the rocks' north side). u 34850-36000: only a faint line at v ~1590-1600 (est). u 36000-36850: a dark band v 1590-1680, clear. WHICH SIDE IS HIGHER cannot be read for sure: the dark face is visible, so by the rule used everywhere here it faces the viewer and the pale band (north) is higher than the near ground; if the pale band is water, this is simply the near shore and the ground south of it is the higher. Below it, to the silk's edge at v ~1786, streaked bare ground: lower_band_top is the top of a second dark band (v ~1662-1720, clear at u 33000-33300, est east of it). West of u 33000 these are structures_w's S1.grd.bank_32700 (v 1578-1614) and S1.grd.bank_32705 (v 1659-1714); their top line reads ~25 px higher than mine at u 33000-33150. MERGE: continues west of u 33000 as structures_w's S1.grd.bank_32700 (at u 33000: top 1580/1610, foot 1612/1640: structures_e reads the band about 30 px lower, so its top meets this bank's foot (both low)). SECOND PASS (start): the dark face runs on east of u 36850 with a clear top edge. The light-to-dark step was read on column profiles (32 px columns, 5 px bins, blur 1.5): 36600 at 1605/1620, 36700 at 1605/1630, 36850 at 1637 (weak), 36950 at 1632 (sharp, 123 -> 104), 37050 at 1640 (126 -> 111), 37150 at 1635 (weak), 37250 at 1630 (134 -> 126, fading). By 37300-37350 only a trace remains, so it ends at about 37250, under plain silk (mist). Its lower edge is clear only at 36950 (1665-1670). West of the bridge the top edge measures 1588 at 35900, 1578 at 36050, 1585 at 36200, 1605 at 36350 and 36500, and 1612 at 36600 (points replaced, within about 10 px of the old ones). West of about 35850 nothing is drawn. At 35450-35750 the whole lower half (v 1340-1770) is one even mid-tone with no step, and a vertical silk crease runs at u 35500-35520. So the est stretch 34850-35850 is a join across bare silk, not a reading of strokes. Below this face, at 36000-36950, a second dark band lies at v ~1700-1765, just above the silk's lower edge (v 1770): the east continuation of `lower_band_top` (not proposed as a line; it runs off the silk).

SECOND PASS (start): this is one layered ink-wash bank face. The strokes lie in three layers, v ~840-860, 880-916 and 932-968 at 37160-37400 (rootband_z25.jpg), with the trees' roots in them. FRAME AGENT: the two trees on this face (S1.tree.slender_bare_37018, S1.tree.elm_bare_37140) stay on `ground`: the frame's `bank slope` (H -0.35) is the stream bank's face half way down to the water, and this bank rises above the road, so it would put them too far north. entities.name: dark slope in front of the pale grove
entities.what: A dark diagonal ink-wash band running from the grove's foot down to the east in front of the pale grove trees, with a sharp lower edge: the face of a low slope or bank, the grove standing on its top.
entities.vis: faded
entities.note: MERGE (t7 left it to structures_e, which had not recorded it): the band runs from about (35450, 770) to (35530, 855) (t7) and its lower edge is a sharp line, read on darkness profiles at u 35460-35640 (light ground from v 815 at 35460, 855-860 at 35490-35520, 846 at 35550, 838 at 35580, 828 at 35610-35640). Higher side north (the grove's feet, v 745-775, stand on its top); height judged under 1 m, depth mixed in. BOTH READINGS: a slope in front of the grove (t7, taken) or the grove trunks' lower parts (t6 read the west trunks' feet at v 890-915 here); the merge's grey crop shows no trunk outline crossing the band.
